messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a weird spike in per-key quota hits for a handful of customers using proxy-service keys around 10:05 UTC. Requests are being blocked even though org-level quotas look fine. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yeah noticed it too. appears tied to token-exchange paths (/v1/exchange). lots of 429s downstream.

devin: throwing up a quick query — check `sum(rate(auth_token_exchanges_total{status="error"}[5m])) by (error_type, key_id)` — lots of `missing_principal` errors pointing at our proxy path.

eric: oh, that's the header we add for delegated calls. if proxy isn't preserving X-Request-Principal we attribute to the proxy key and bucket against that key's quota instead of the originating SA.

maya: exactly — users see their app throttled even though they'd expect org quota to absorb it. breaking for apps doing cross-tenant proxying.

console-team: UX question: when this happens customers will complain. can we show a per-request "effective principal" column in the quota dashboard and surface token-exchange failures in the key detail page? thinking quick toggle to include exchange traces.

devin: quick PoC query for tracing: `trace_id = jaeger.search({service="auth", operation="token_exchange"}) | where tags.missing_principal` — returns the exchange span. we can surface span link from console.

eric: security note — exposing effective principal in the UI is safe for customer owners but we should gate it behind an owner/admin permission. also avoid leaking other org ids.

maya: +1 on gating. short-term mitigation: change routing to prefer org quota when exchange fails with missing_principal (fallback logic). longer-term: fix proxy to forward X-Effective-Principal reliably.

oncall-bot: ALERT: 429 spike on auth-proxy detected — 120 events in 2m — linked to thread 1719077777.

sam: mitigation steps I can run now: 1) add fallback in quota router, 2) hotfix probe to assert header forwarding, 3) add quick metric dashboard for token-exchange failures. will open PRs.

console-team: we'll mock a dashboard tile: "Token Exchange Failures (per-key)" and add drilldown to traces + toggle to reveal effective principal for admins.

maya: awesome. action items: sam PR for router fallback, devin add metric + trace link, eric update RBAC gating in console, console-team add UX tile. i'll coordinate CS comms. thanks all :pray:
